headline: The fossil fuel comeback is here
summary: US fossil fuel infrastructure building hits a decade high. Renewable energy growth is slowing down significantly. Electricity demand is surging due to data centers, factories, and EVs.

headline: CoreWeave’s debt is becoming the whole AI industry’s problem
summary: CoreWeave's bonds entered distressed territory as investor demands rose. Chamath Palihapitiya questions if the AI buildout signals a private credit bubble. The company's debt situation could indicate broader issues for the AI industry.

headline: I tried a $99 plug that promises to track your car and send help when needed — without selling your data
summary: Review of the Miles Plug, a $99 device for vehicle tracking. It monitors location, driving habits, and offers emergency response. The plug claims to prioritize user data privacy.

headline: Sony’s best noise-canceling earbuds are nearly $100 off today only
summary: Sony's WF-1000XM6 noise-canceling earbuds are $92 off. They are currently cheaper than their last-gen counterpart, the XM5s. This limited-time deal makes them an all-time low price of $238.

headline: Hellraiser's Clive Barker Feared New Game Would Be 'Overly Censored' But Is 'Proud as F**k at the End Result'
summary: Hellraiser creator Clive Barker worried about censorship in the new game. He is now 'proud as f**k' of the game's final direction. Barker praises how far the developers pushed the boundaries.

headline: Get 6.6ft 240W USB Type-C Cables for Less Than $3 Apiece
summary: Deal offers 6.6ft 240W USB Type-C cables for under $3 each. These universal cables are suitable for various gaming devices. They are compatible with Nintendo Switch 2, Steam Deck, and laptops.

headline: Steam Fans Are Begging for a No-AI Filter as Steam Next Fest Is Filled With Slop
summary: Steam Next Fest is experiencing an influx of low-effort games. Fans are demanding a filter to exclude AI-generated content. The festival is reportedly 'filled with slop,' sparking user frustration.

headline: Arkham Horror: Remastered Preview and Exclusive Art Reveal
summary: A preview of the upcoming Arkham Horror: Remastered game. The article includes an exclusive reveal of new artwork. It offers insights into the remastered version of the popular game.

headline: Curfew imposed in parts of central Paris and other cities after rioting across France
summary: Curfews have been imposed in Paris and other French cities. This follows widespread rioting across the country. The interior minister admitted police 'lost control' in some areas.

headline: Watch: Clean up begins after French riots but police remain
summary: Clean-up efforts have started in France after recent riots. Police presence remains high in affected areas. Marseille saw over 600 looted premises, suffering severe damage.

headline: Australian MP critically injured after being hit by car in apparent attack
summary: An Australian independent MP was critically injured by a car. The prime minister suggests it may have been a deliberate attack. The politician is currently hospitalized following the incident.

headline: Ukrainians dying because US restricting intelligence sharing, Zelensky adviser tells BBC
summary: A Zelensky adviser claims Ukrainians are dying due to US intelligence sharing restrictions. Serhii Beskrestnov says there isn't enough warning time for missile attacks. The White House denies any changes to intelligence sharing policies.
